title: RFC: SM90 (H20-3E) support for DeepInfer
body: RFC for single-server SM90 support, scoped to 4x H20-3E (141 GB) and offline inference. The native FP4 checkpoint fits (~499 GB of 564 GB); the core work is a dequant-fused FP8 grouped GEMM (SM90 has no FP4 tensor core) and Hopper attention kernels (FlashMLA dropped Hopper on 2026.09.30). This draft adds only the RFC document; implementation would follow separately, as with #46.
